Boost neutrality forces a=0, but the neutral cross bilinear has zero pair-annihilation matrix element on the pure source (|Upsilon^3>+|Omega^3>)/sqrt(2). The responding choice C=I has charge branches +2 and -2. Couple them to a pointer with a neutral ground and two exchanged click states of charges -2 and +2. The combined pair map preserves total charge, intertwines ghost parity, and is an isometry from the normalized pure even source to a normalized positive even pointer-spectator state. On the tagged angle family the pure channel excludes mask 7, so its t/u angular coefficient is 2 rather than the imported 10; its tree quadrupole moment is one fifth of the certified positive moment. The active loop has the same positive complement species eigenvector. The compact q8 bound therefore survives without the logarithmic scalar parity image.
